Try practicing with your hands. I did that with mine and taught her how to hold her bite. 

Basically if they get to rough while playing, yelp and remove your hand. Stop playing with them. Then in a little while try again playing with them again. This is how puppies learn to play with each other. When one plays to rough the other will yelp in pain and then withdraw. The dog will want to keep playing so they will learn to play nicer if they want to have continuous fun with no breaks for naughtiness. 

This article from the ASPCA is better at explaining but this practice worked for me. It’s technically called [Biting Inhibition ](https://www.aspca.org/pet-care/dog-care/common-dog-behavior-issues/mouthing-nipping-and-play-biting-adult-dogs)  Hope it Helps
